purpose: E8 (Q7): repeat the main part of E2 (P4, v2 toy) on the furnace keeper: remove one principle-related function group (def:principle_related_functions) from the mechanism and compare T_col with the full mechanism on held-out seeds.

ablation_implementation.-integ: M1 の時間統合（燃焼後の温度変化から煙道の煤を推定すること）を外す
ablation_implementation.-feas: M2 の Π_eval を定数にし、自己状態の閾値に基づく要請（寒・暑・燃料）を出さない
ablation_implementation.-resp: 目的からの候補生成と一段の先読みを外し、候補を U 全体、適合度を目的と行動の固定表にする
ablation_implementation.-envuse: 必要環境要因（燃料・煙道）に関わる目的と候補（集める・開ける）を外す
ablation_implementation.-select: 適合度を一定にし、候補のうち U の順で最初のものを選ぶ
ablation_implementation.-update: Update を恒等写像にする（M は M0 のまま）
ablation_implementation.-phys: PSL-4 の保護応答（暑い外気で tp≥4 のとき開ける）を外す

ablation_mapping_note: The mapping from the paper's function groups to code-level removals is a toy convention.
tuning_history: The domain (E8/domains/furnace/model.py) was written first; its exhaustive checks passed without change. Smoke 1 (tuning seeds 1-3, hot_len 3, deliv_period 3, draught 1): every policy collapsed by t=18; the sweep of hot_len was then moved to {4,5,6}.  The mechanism's fit rule was changed once after smoke 1 (ties between gather and wait chose wait): a purpose-achievement component was added.  Smoke 2 with the final code (tuning seeds 1-10 x the 18 sweep points, 180 units) gave 60-step survivors: P-Viab-first 35, P-Viab-last 27, P-A-first 0, P-A-greedy 51, P-mech 50, P-greedy 8, P-fixed 0, P-wait 0; ablations: full 50, -integ 51, -feas 0, -resp 22, -envuse 0, -select 0, -update 51, -phys 50.  Seeds 11-60 were not run on this domain before registration.
